source.name: O'Neills (official FRR shop): Rugby Romania Rugby Replica Jersey
source.quote: Features club crest and sponsor details.
source.note: The official replica of the Romania match jersey, sold in O'Neills' online shop, which the federation's own site links to as its 'Rugby Shop' (rugbyromania.ro footer). The official product photos on that page show the red Kaufland logo in a white square centre front, below the O'Neills hero (right chest) and the Rugby Romania crest (left chest). Kaufland is the federation's partner: FRR and Kaufland Romania created the 'Liga de Rugby Kaufland' in December 2023 (despre.kaufland.ro press release, 08.12.2023).

source.name: O'Neills (official FRR shop): Rugby Romania Rugby Replica Jersey — back view
source.quote: Features club crest and sponsor details.
source.note: The official back-view product photo on the same page shows the white 'OMV Petrom' wordmark with the Petrom logo across the upper back, below the collar. OMV Petrom (omvpetrom.com) is also on the federation's partner bar (rugbyromania.ro footer).

source.name: O'Neills (official FRR shop): Rugby Romania Rugby Replica Jersey — back view (lower back)
source.quote: Features club crest and sponsor details.
source.note: The official back-view product photo shows the round 'Agenția Națională pentru Sport' mark with the Romanian government crest on the lower back, next to the wordmark 'AGENTIA NATIONALA PENTRU SPORT'. The National Agency for Sport is the Romanian state sports body (sport.gov.ro, on the federation's partner bar).

source.name: O'Neills (official FRR shop): Rugby Romania Rugby Replica Jersey — sleeve
source.quote: Features club crest and sponsor details.
source.note: The official product photos show the white 'XP' mark with a pendulum graphic on the wearer's left sleeve (front and back views). It matches XP Group's logo ('XP — Towards Sustainable Upstream Operations'), the partner shown on the federation's partner bar linking to xp-group.com (rugbyromania.ro footer); no announcement naming the sleeve deal was found.

source.name: Rugby Romania (FRR): Stejarii au un nou sponsor de echipament sportiv: O'Neills. Parteneriatul este pe trei ani și va include și Cupa Mondială de Rugby
source.quote: Parteneriatul tehnic încheiat cu O'Neills este valabil pentru următoarele trei sezoane, incluzând și Cupa Mondială din Australia 2027.
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. The federation announced on 26 November 2025 the three-season technical partnership (2026-2028) with the Irish manufacturer, signed the day before at O'Neills' Giurgiu factory; the O'Neills hero logo sits on the right chest of the shirt. Translation: 'The technical partnership concluded with O'Neills is valid for the next three seasons, including the Rugby World Cup in Australia 2027.'

summary: Romania's current home shirt is made by O'Neills, which became the federation's technical partner for three seasons (2026-2028) in November 2025 after 15 years with other suppliers. The official product photos on O'Neills' shop (linked from rugbyromania.ro) show Kaufland centre front, OMV Petrom across the upper back, the state sports agency Agenția Națională pentru Sport on the lower back and XP Group on the left sleeve; a Rugby Europe competition patch sits on the right sleeve. The official photo of the match shorts shows only the federation crest and the O'Neills logo — no commercial sponsor. Nothing found on any sponsor; OMV Petrom's Abu Dhabi connection (~13% indirect stake via ADNOC in OMV) is proposed at concern.
